Exercise 9. a) The Ministry of Culture (represented by the Secretary-General) signed a memorandum of understanding with an Italian university (represented by the rector). Objectives: to develop cooperation in translation and heritage protection. Measures: exchange of students and researchers, a joint annual conference, ten scholarships per year for the best students in the two countries. The ambassador of Italy was present. From the date of signature, for three years renewable. It is a primary source (official communication); contains the title ⁧سَعَادَة⁩ (for the Ambassador). b) Legislative (the parliament) discusses and votes the laws and controls the government; the executive (the government) applies the laws and administers the country through ministries; the court (s) decides disputes and protects rights. The principle that no power dominates the other two. In governorates, wilayas or regions depending on the country, then municipalities, which deal with services close to citizens (cleaning, transport, gardens).
